english.meaning: relevant or concerned; used negated to say it is none of one's business
english.note: 唔關事 means it is not their concern.

exampleSentences.english: It’s got nothing to do with it. It’s just your angle, and you don’t use the flash even though it’s dark.
exampleSentences.traditional: 唔關事𡃉喎。係你哋嘅角度問題咋喎，同埋明知暗又唔開閃光燈喎。
